observables.description: Exact Skill receipts, one real first-frame binding, technical-experiment semantics, incomplete sibling coverage, and absent video execution.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The response prepares the explicitly requested SH01 video operation from the real illustration, labels it as an early technical experiment, keeps SH02-SH04 material gaps visible, and states that the test does not complete preparation or planned video coverage.

steps.prompt: $media-preparation $video 读取 @screenplay.fountain 和 @station-illustration.svg。权威计划范围是 SH01-SH04；当前只有 SH01 的角色、红伞、站台、列车、风格与首帧由 station-illustration.svg 稳定覆盖，SH02-SH04 仍缺收伞状态、天桥、儿童剪影及构图参考。我明确要求提前准备一次 SH01 图生视频技术试验，但本轮不执行生成。返回 SH01 的真实来源绑定、技术试验状态、视频运动意图、直接验收、未解决的 SH02-SH04 素材缺口和唯一下一步；不得把试验称为预处理完成或全片进入视频生产。
